current_disclosures.summary: Effective July 1, 2025, gains and losses on certain economic and qualifying hedging derivatives and foreign currency transaction gains/losses related to non-U.S. dollar debt and certain foreign operations are now presented within Principal transactions, replacing their previous presentation within Other revenue, with prior periods conformed.

Effective July 1, 2025, certain predominantly variable expenses for ongoing product and service support are aggregated into a new 'Transactional and product servicing' category, while certain non-income tax charges are presented within Other operating expenses, replacing previous presentations within Transactional and tax charges, with prior periods conformed.

Effective January 1, 2025, certain transaction processing fees paid by Citi, primarily to credit card networks, are now presented as contra-revenue within Commissions and fees in Non-interest revenue, replacing their previous presentation within Other operating expenses for USPB, Services, Wealth, and All Other-Legacy Franchises, with prior periods conformed.

Effective January 1, 2025, USPB changed its reporting for certain installment lending products transferred from Retail Banking to Branded Cards to reflect where these products are managed, with prior periods conformed.
